selection_reason: CORVUS replaces stale append-only read snapshots with synchronized file context, reducing average input tokens 9–50% and reasoning cycles up to 37% in coding-agent inference.
title: CORVUS: Context Optimization and Reduction Via Underlying Synchronization for LLM Coding Agents
